en.map.html.s017: Enable JavaScript to view the map and editor. Your experiences are processed in your browser.
en.map.html.s022: Local natural-terrain basemap without national or administrative boundaries. Points indicate city centers; click a city, or select it with Tab and press Enter, to view experiences. This is not a navigation map.

en.map.html.s096: On desktop, drag to pan and scroll to zoom; use arrow keys to pan and ＋ / − to zoom. On mobile, swipe over the embedded map to scroll the page, or use the browser's pinch gesture to zoom the page. Choose “Use map · Expand” below to drag with one finger and pinch to zoom the map. Exit at the top right of the expanded map, or jump to the tools and exports that remain below it. Tap a place to see experiences. On desktop, double-click empty space to add a visitor draft; on mobile, use “Add experience.”
en.map.html.s097: Record multiple stays in the same city. Dates may be precise to the year, month, or day; leave unknown dates blank. Select “Approximate” for approximate dates. For manually entered places, check the city, country or region, and city-center coordinates.
en.map.html.s098: Visitor drafts are processed only in your browser and are not saved automatically. JSON and Markdown restore the data; images save only the picture. Undo and Clear draft affect only visitor drafts, leaving the author's timeline unchanged.
en.map.html.s099: Lines indicate chronological order only. Scenes returning to a long-term home do not invent a return date. Keep the page in the foreground while generating video.
